Expected Result: No plaintext secrets or personal credentials committed to version control
Actual Result: Plaintext Gmail App Password and Razorpay Test Secret committed in properties file
Root Cause: Credentials placed directly in git-tracked properties rather than resolved from environment
Recommended Fix: Revoke committed keys immediately; replace with ${MAIL_PASSWORD} and ${RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET} environment placeholders

Test Scenario: Subscribe to volunteer alerts topic with non-volunteer user
Expected Result: Only vetted volunteers with VERIFIED status should be allowed to receive emergency coordinates
Actual Result: Any authenticated user can subscribe and receive real-time victim coordinates; loop causes N duplicate broadcasts
Root Cause: Permissive check in STOMP interceptor and topic broadcast inside volunteer loop
Recommended Fix: Enforce volunteer verification check in interceptor; convert to point-to-point user queues (/user/queue/alerts)

Test Scenario: Client submits tampered lower price for service booking
Expected Result: Server strictly calculates price from service catalog entity
Actual Result: Server accepts client-provided amount on unrecognized types and confirms booking at ₹1
Root Cause: createOrder falls back to client amount; verify fails to validate amountPaid == service.getPrice()
Recommended Fix: Remove client amount fallback; enforce database price resolution for all booking types in createOrder and verify

Test Scenario: Application boots with existing financial video metadata
Expected Result: Schema migrations managed via Flyway; existing data preserved
Actual Result: Raw ALTER TABLE executed on boot; financial video duration and level wiped to NULL
Root Cause: Unprofiled CommandLineRunner executing raw DDL and destructive UPDATE statements
Recommended Fix: Delete DatabaseSchemaUpdate.java; move any required DDL to Flyway migration V52

Test Scenario: Client initiates HTTPS connection to platform domain
Expected Result: HTTPS enforced with valid TLS certificate and HSTS headers
Actual Result: Nginx listens on port 80 HTTP only; no TLS certificate or HTTPS redirection configured
Root Cause: Missing SSL/TLS server block in Nginx configuration
Recommended Fix: Configure Let's Encrypt / Certbot; add port 443 SSL server block; redirect port 80 to HTTPS

Test Scenario: User in emergency triggers SOS to notify contacts
Expected Result: Emergency SMS sent to trusted contacts
Actual Result: SMS disabled by default and provider keys blank; fails silently while UI displays success
Root Cause: SMS disabled by default in properties; no native SMS fallback on mobile failure
Recommended Fix: Provision Twilio/Msg91 in prod profile; display truthful failure banner if provider is offline

Test Scenario: User logs in via web browser
Expected Result: JWT session cookie marked HttpOnly and Secure
Actual Result: Cookie is HttpOnly but missing Secure flag
Recommended Fix: Set cookie.setSecure(true) when running in HTTPS / production mode

Test Scenario: mvn test runs full integration suite
Expected Result: All integration test suites complete cleanly within heap limits
Actual Result: JVM crashes with OutOfMemoryError in MessageBroker thread due to 1024m heap limit
Evidence: pom.xml line 251; task-140 surefire execution log
Root Cause: Test runner constrained to -Xmx1024m while Spring contexts accumulate in memory
Recommended Fix: Increase Surefire heap to -Xmx2048m and configure forkCount=1 with reuseForks=false

Test Scenario: Concurrent users attempt booking same doctor slot simultaneously
Expected Result: Database rejects second booking via unique index
Actual Result: No DB unique constraint; race condition can cause double-booking under concurrency
Root Cause: Double-booking checks rely solely on application service layer
Recommended Fix: Add unique index uq_doctor_active_slot on doctor_appointments (doctor_id

Test Scenario: Application boots and initializes crime prediction model
Expected Result: Weka model loads pre-trained dataset or trains on ARFF file
Actual Result: Boot logs error: crime_data.arff not found; AI safety prediction disabled
Root Cause: crime_data.arff training dataset not committed to repository root
Recommended Fix: Add crime_data.arff dataset or replace with pre-trained serialized model binary

Test Scenario: Location permission permanently denied on mobile device
Expected Result: App guides user directly to OS App Settings
Actual Result: App sets static text banner but button remains active without opening settings
Root Cause: Geolocator.openAppSettings() not called on deniedForever status
Recommended Fix: Invoke Geolocator.openAppSettings() when permission is permanently denied

Test Scenario: User visits heatmap without Google Maps API key
Expected Result: UI displays helpful fallback message explaining missing key
Actual Result: Map renders as blank grey box with JavaScript console error
Root Cause: Missing API key check in frontend template
Recommended Fix: Display user-friendly banner when Google Maps API key is empty
